source_instruction: i am looking for 3mp motion detection security camera.
query: Oh man, I spent 20 minutes this morning trying to get my sourdough starter to stop smelling like old gym socks—turns out I fed it way too much whole wheat flour yesterday and it went a little feral, so I had to dump half of it and feed it a tiny bit of bread flour to calm it down. I also remembered I need to pick up those fuzzy cat socks I saw last week with the little tuna fish prints on them before they sell out, my tabby would lose her mind if I missed those. Oh, and I’ve been meaning to rewatch that old 90s skateboarding video my friends and I used to loop in high school, I can’t remember if it’s on the free streaming service or if I have to dig out my old DVD copy. Anyway, I’m looking for video surveillance cameras right now—they have to have motion detection, 3mp resolution is what I’m going for, and the most I want to spend is that one.
